source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Because the main and sensor boards slide vertically into the enclosure rails, each is mounted with its long edge at the top. Put the high-pin-count main connectors along that long top edge on both boards, with none on either side or the bottom. On the main board, J\_SENSOR\_PWR and J\_SENSOR\_SIG must line up with J\_SENSOR\_PWR and J\_SENSOR\_SIG on the sensor board at the same relative locations along the top edge; this keeps the inter-board cables short and lets them run straight between the boards.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Since this is a prototype, the dimensions and similar details can change. In the layout, the small sensor board is on the left, the main board is in the middle, and the power board is on the right. The important point is that they stand vertically: cables will be easier to connect from the top, while smaller connectors can go on the sides.

value_updates.enclosure_board_order: sensor board on the left, main board in the middle, and power board on the right

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
My rough calculation gives a 140×100 board an area of 14000mm², with the components occupying about 5200mm², or ~37% coverage. That still seems comfortably within normal PCB density and should route cleanly on 8 layers.

Rather than consolidating everything into a 2x24+12p, I'd like to retain the individual JST connectors. The modular arrangement matters for the enclosure: every sensor gets its own clean cable, and the boards slide into rails. A single large connector feeding a fan-out ribbon cable would leave the enclosure wiring messy and difficult to service.

Because the components are already placed in KiCad, could you resize the outline to 140×100 and make a rough rearrangement? I am not proficient with KiCad, so what would take me hours should take you minutes with the complete project already open. I would really appreciate you trying the resize on your side.

Keeping the ESP32 on the edge is fine.

value_updates.connector_configuration: retain individual JST connectors rather than consolidating them into one large connector

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Because they are L-shaped now, please replace them with regular straight connectors that point away from the board.

value_updates.connector_orientation: regular straight connectors pointing away from the board instead of L-shaped connectors
